Annual price index bundled with the package

Source: R/rollup.R
us_price_index.Rd

CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, annual averages (1982-84 = 100), from the Bureau of Labor Statistics. The 2025 value is the provisional annual average; check BLS for revisions before publication-grade work, or supply your own series via the index argument of us_adjust_inflation() – a two-column data.frame of year and index (any consistent base year works, since only ratios are used).

Usage

us_price_index()

Value

A data.table of year, index.

Examples

us_price_index()
#>      year   index
#>     <int>   <num>
#>  1:  2007 207.342
#>  2:  2008 215.303
#>  3:  2009 214.537
#>  4:  2010 218.056
